pack.title: Source-backed interview practice - manually authored
pack.role_summary: Twelve documentation-grounded practice questions. Not reported company questions or live model outputs.

questions.question: A config dictionary may lack 'timeout'. How would you safely default to 30, and what if the stored value is None?
questions.expected_answer: Use config.get('timeout', 30). An existing None remains None; handle that explicitly if needed.
